content.short: Meow is business banking that natively supports stablecoin payments, treasury and invoicing.
content.description: Meow is a business banking platform for startups and global teams, combining accounts, invoicing, treasury management and high-yield options, and was among the first to natively support sending and receiving stablecoins. Stable's official ecosystem page lists Meow.
content.meta: Meow is business banking with native stablecoin payments and treasury tools, listed on Stable.
